verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a developer API platform covering cards, payments, transactions and expense data, including a transaction query endpoint (POST /v1/cards/transactions) secured by mTLS and OAuth 2.0. Developers can therefore read the financial records that feed accounting. There is no evidence of a dedicated accounting API for managing accounting-specific data, and the NetSuite/QuickBooks/Xero sync is a packaged integration rather than an API. Missing for 10: a dedicated accounting API (GL codes, categories, accounting sync status), documented write/manage operations on accounting data, a public OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
